procedural_exemplar_value: Demonstrates how a single grounded rock vault, nonuniform nested cavities and dual lateral traverse corridors can constrain and reunite multi-part industrial machines while preserving playable human-editable voids.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike recent exterior process-line, open crater, single faultline and severed cableway exemplars, Tern-5 makes excavation depth and nested negative cavities the primary architecture; three distinct traffic strata are connected by five serviced shaft nodes.
physically_claimed_behavior: Inert authored solids only; initial sealed water/lava and independent route clearances verified statically. No active pressure pumping, reactor, cycling machinery, moving doors, thermal transient, or native runtime operation claimed.
